design_blocker.summary: Contract g1.0 requires full ascending replay from sid:0, but the owner requires latest canonical activity first with older history loaded only by upward scrolling.

status_definitions.PASS_LOCAL_REVIEWED: Retained local evidence and applicable bounded independent reviews exist; not hosted CI or overall G1 acceptance.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Useful evidence exists but at least one required case, final review, or design-dependent assertion remains open.
status_definitions.BLOCKED_DESIGN: The row cannot be accepted until the product/API contract is revised.
status_definitions.NOT_RUN: No retained row-level execution evidence was established.
